ability.rites_and_paths.angelic_form.des: For a few seconds you fly (no sprinting in the air). On activation your negative effects and those of nearby allies are purged, and all of you get Regeneration II and Absorption I while it lasts. You take no fall damage when it ends.
ability.rites_and_paths.healer_eye.desc: You see the health of nearby allies above their heads (even through walls). Those below 40% glow, and allies downed by Miracle show their countdown. Only you can see it.
ability.rites_and_paths.healer_eye.name: Healer's Eye
You heal the ally you are looking at (nearby) for 30% of their maximum health, without spending mana. Scales with your holy power. Lifts a downed ally.
ability.rites_and_paths.miracle.desc: If an ally was about to die near you, they are downed for a few seconds instead: they cannot act or take damage. If another player heals them, they get back up; if not, they die. Each ally can only be saved this way every so often. It does not save you.
ability.rites_and_paths.miracle.name: Miracle
ability.rites_and_paths.prayer.desc: Pick an ally from the list: your body stays kneeling and your camera moves to a small angel that orbits your ally and gives them Regeneration. Your spells, Laying on Hands and Sanctuary come from the angel; spells lose power if your body is far away. Press again to switch ally or stop praying.
ability.rites_and_paths.prayer.name: Prayer
ability.rites_and_paths.sacrifice.desc: You pay part of your maximum health and the ally you are looking at recovers part of theirs (at least what you paid). No cooldown. If paying would kill you, the icon turns red: press twice to give your life and heal your ally for half of their health, with a moment of invulnerability.
ability.rites_and_paths.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
ability.rites_and_paths.sanctuary.desc: Hold the key: a holy sphere surrounds you, pushes enemies out and blocks their projectiles. It absorbs damage to anyone inside until it breaks. It costs mana every second; when released it lasts half as long as you held it. While holding it you move slower and cannot cast spells.
ability.rites_and_paths.sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.desc: Part of the excess healing (above maximum health) turns into absorption for a few seconds.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.name: Aegis
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.blessing.d: The beneficial effects you give with your spells last longer. Does not affect class abilities.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.divine_res: More maximum mana and more mana regeneration.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.healing.de: Your spells heal more and give more absorption (also those you cast on yourself). Does not affect class abilities.
branch.rites_and_paths.cleric.purificati: Your heals shorten the negative effects on whoever you heal.
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.desc: Holy healer: a kind of healing mage who shares the holy school with the Paladin. Their holy magic has no wall and every other school loses 35%. Very weak with weapons, armor and shields. Heals, extends buffs, purifies, protects with shields of light and saves allies from the final blow.
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.name: Cleric
class.rites_and_paths.cleric.trait: Class trait: slightly higher maximum health.
death.attack.rites_and_paths.martyrdom: %1$s gave their life for their allies
death.attack.rites_and_paths.martyrdom.p: %1$s gave their life for their allies while fighting %2$s
mechanic.rites_and_paths.absolution.name: Absolution
mechanic.rites_and_paths.aegis.name: Aegis
mechanic.rites_and_paths.deep_aegis.name: Deep Aegis
mechanic.rites_and_paths.far_voice.name: Distant Voice
mechanic.rites_and_paths.halo.name: Halo
mechanic.rites_and_paths.own_faith.name: Own Faith
mechanic.rites_and_paths.penance.name: Penance
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.ally_down: %s is down! Heal them within %s s.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.downed: You are down! If an ally heals you within %s s, you get back up.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.final_arm: Final Sacrifice: press again to give your life for %s.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.no_mana: You do not have enough mana.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.no_target: You are not looking at any ally within reach.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.prayer_lo: The prayer is broken: %s is no longer within your reach.
message.rites_and_paths.cleric.prayer_no: There are no allies within reach to pray for.
param.rites_and_paths.heal_bonus: Healing and absorption of your spells
param.rites_and_paths.recovery: You recover of what you heal
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.deep_a: You turn much less excess into absorption, but the cap rises to half your maximum health.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.aegis.swift_: You turn more excess into absorption, but the cap drops a lot.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.blessing.gre: Your buffs go up one level (up to III), but cost more mana and last a bit less.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.blessing.sel: Your area buffs only affect you, but last much longer.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.divine_reser: You regenerate much more mana out of combat and a bit less in combat.
Less maximum mana; truly healing someone else recovers part of the spell's mana.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.healing.life: Your spells heal you much less, but you recover half of what you heal others (up to 3 per cast).
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.healing.own_: Your spells heal you much more, but others much less.
perk.rites_and_paths.cleric.purification: Your first heal on each ally every so often removes all their negative effects, but the branch reduction is halved.
What you cut from a negative effect passes to the nearest enemy, with half that duration.
subclass.rites_and_paths.angel.desc: Wings of light: less fall damage and slow fall, a halo that regenerates nearby allies and, from level 5, Angelic Form: you fly for a few seconds while you and your allies regenerate and are purified.
subclass.rites_and_paths.angel.name: Angel
subclass.rites_and_paths.intercessor.des: Prays for an ally even without seeing them: your body stays kneeling and your sight moves to a small angel that accompanies them. You cast your spells from the angel, with less power the farther away your body is.
subclass.rites_and_paths.martyr.desc: Heals with their own blood: more health, less damage taken when badly hurt and, from level 5, Sacrifice: you pay health to heal an ally, with no cooldown. If you can no longer pay, you can give your life for them.
subclass.rites_and_paths.martyr.name: Martyr
ui.rites_and_paths.prayer.title: Prayer: who do you pray for?
